payload.body: hv's go (23 Oct): build issues 0041 and 0042 together, specified live by SendMessage. 0041: zsh_check renders the iTerm2 ssh wrapper to a temp file with the same generator and fails, naming the file, when it differs from disk or is missing. 0042: the generator takes the house domains from Molt-matts config/network/local-domains (one per line, # comments) and writes <host>|<host>.<domain>... for each; lan, local and hockenbury.internal go in that file. Test under both bashes, commit by pathspec, close both, tell vc; vc pushes.
